reason: I'd take the free first counted collab and see if a café owner even bothers with the coupon at the counter. I'm not paying for the pass until I have real counts to put in my media kit next to my rate card.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money. A counter tally won't change that unless the owner and his staff actually ask for the coupon every time, and in a busy South Bengaluru café they won't.
would_change_my_mind: One café actually paying me cash after I showed them my 'customers I brought' count from the free collab.
